subject: geom_smooth with loess: setting the span parameter

messages.author: e83d54ec65b5b8e6
messages.subject: geom_smooth with loess: setting the span parameter
parts:
In a scatterplot produced with geom_points i would like to use
geom_smooth(method=loess,  ) and I want to change the span
parameter used when loess is called. How can I do this>

messages.author: da3e61cf16146892
messages.subject: Re: geom_smooth with loess: setting the span parameter
parts:
In addition to the arguments that are expressly listed in the documentation for geom_smooth(), there is also a "...".  As I understand it, this means it also passes along additional arguments to its internal functions.

In this case, since "span" can be specified for loess, defining it in geom_smooth causes it to be automatically passed on to loess.  See the examples below.  

library(ggplot2) 
c <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(qsec, wt))+geom_point()
c + stat_smooth(method="loess",span=0.5)
c + stat_smooth(method="loess",span=0.75)
c + stat_smooth(method="loess",span=0.85)
c + stat_smooth(method="loess",span=0.95)
